method: Signed tetrahedral integration of closed component meshes, followed by parallel-axis aggregation. Overlapping component volumes are summed; modeled shells and motors are equivalent solid envelopes.
assumptions: Uniform density within each measured mass category, not one density shared across the entire machine.
No measured shell thickness, internal motor or battery construction, or individual component masses.
Body inertia is about its own center of mass in body coordinate axes; link body origin is the passive hinge.
Measured 150 g category excludes hinge knuckles, tongues, and their fasteners.
Collision contacts remain disabled; actuator/friction/damping data remain provisional.
